name: How long does a garage door installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a garage door installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard garage door installations typically take between four to eight hours once materials arrive on site. However, the total project timeline depends on whether framing adjustments or custom trim are needed around the opening. As a general contractor, Abraham Becerra assesses existing jambs, headers, and rough openings beforehand. If your project involves widening the opening, repairing water-damaged framing, or installing custom drywall and exterior trim, the work can extend into a multi-day garage renovation. We manage these carpentry and structural requirements alongside the door placement.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard garage door replacement takes four to eight hours. If framing repairs, header modifications, or new interior drywall are needed, work can take one to two days.
